title: Nexus Energy Limited - proposed acquisition of Anzon Australia Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Nexus Energy Limited (Nexus) proposes to acquire Anzon Australia (Anzon)
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC did not consider it necessary to define the relevant market for the purposes of assessing this merger.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition, primarily because the merged entity would face competition from a number of much larger oil and gas companies in the regions in which it will operate.
